examples.text: n'accantavaṇṇā na bahūnaṃ kantā, na dakkhiṇā pamadā sevitabbā, na parassa bhariyā na dhanassa hetu, et'itthiyo pañca na sevitabbā'ti.

83068.meaning1: predicting unusual events; prognostication of disasters
83068.commentary: (DNa) uppātan'ti asanipāt'ādīnaṃ mahantānaṃ uppatitaṃ, tañ'hi disvā idaṃ bhavissati, evaṃ bhavissatī'ti ādisanti.

examples.text: yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, aṅgaṃ nimittaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ mūsikacchinnaṃ

83069.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of abbhantara
83069.construction:
abhi > abhy > abbh + anta + ra + aṃ
abbhantara + aṃ
83069.commentary: (JAa) abbhantaran'ti paṭhamaṃ mama abbhantaraṃ āsanaṃ āsi, alaṅ'kata-mahātalamhi ussitasetacchatte rājapallaṅke'y'eva maṃ nisīdāpesuṃ.

examples.text: ehi, bhante, abbhantaraṃ ghaṭṭetvā bahi mocehi… bahi ghaṭṭetvā abbhantaraṃ mocehi, evaṃ te anāpatti bhavissatī'ti. so bhikkhu tathā akāsi.
abbhantaraṃ pure āsi, tato majjhe tato bahi, purā niddhamanā hoti, sayam'eva vajām'ahaṃ.

83070.meaning1: turns back; turns around; goes away

examples.text: yathā, mahārāja, puriso rañño cakkavattissa madhuṃ vā madhupiṇḍikaṃ vā aññaṃ vā upāyanaṃ abhihareyya, tam'enaṃ rañño dvārapālo evaṃ vadeyya akālo, bho, ayaṃ rañño dassanāya, tena hi, bho, tava upāyanaṃ gahetvā sīghasīghaṃ paṭinivatta, pure tava rājā daṇḍaṃ dhāressatī'ti.

83071.meaning1: (vinaya) who is defeated; who is expelled

examples.text: āpatti pārājikassā'ti na kevalaṃ tass'eva, sañcicca tassa atthasādhane pavattānaṃ kūṭavinicchayikānam'pi kūṭasakkhīnam'pi sabbesaṃ pārājikaṃ. ettha ca sāmikassa dhuranikkhepavasen'eva parājayo veditabbo. anikkhittadhuro hi aparājito'va hoti.

āpatti pārājikassā'ti na kevalaṃ tass'eva, sañcicca tassa atthasādhane pavattānaṃ kūṭavinicchayikānam'pi kūṭasakkhīnam'pi sabbesaṃ pārājikaṃ. ettha ca sāmikassa dhuranikkhepavasen'eva parājayo veditabbo. anikkhittadhuro hi aparājito'va hoti.

83073.meaningLit: not put down the yoke pole

examples.text: āpatti pārājikassā'ti na kevalaṃ tass'eva, sañcicca tassa atthasādhane pavattānaṃ kūṭavinicchayikānam'pi kūṭasakkhīnam'pi sabbesaṃ pārājikaṃ. ettha ca sāmikassa dhuranikkhepavasen'eva parājayo veditabbo. anikkhittadhuro hi aparājito'va hoti.

83074.meaning1: associates and friends; acquaintances and companions
83074.commentary: (ANt) sandiṭṭhasambhattehī'ti ettha tattha tattha saṅgamma diṭṭhamattā n'ātidaḷhamittā sandiṭṭhā, suṭṭhu bhattā sinehavanto daḷhamittā sambhattā.

examples.text: ye'pi tesaṃ sandiṭṭhasambhattā honti, tesaṃ upatthambhā hutvā na, āvuso, tumhe etehi jātiyā vā gottena vā sīlena vā nihīnatarā. sace tumhe attano gāhaṃ vissajjetha, suṭṭhutaraṃ vo ete adhibhavissantī'ti-ādīni vatvā gāhaṃ vissajjetuṃ na denti.
saha ñātībhī'ti ñātakehi saddhiṃ. saha upajjhāyehī'ti sukhadukkhesu upanijjhāyitabbattā upajjhāyasaṅkhātehi sandiṭṭhasambhattehi saddhiṃ.

83076.meaning1: having stuck; having clung; having attached (to)

examples.text: yathā, mahārāja, jalūkā yattha allīyati, tatth'eva daḷhaṃ allīyitvā ruhiraṃ pivati, evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yog'āvacarena yasmiṃ ārammaṇe cittaṃ allīyati, taṃ ārammaṇaṃ vaṇṇato ca saṇṭhānato ca disato ca okāsato ca paricchedato ca liṅgato ca nimittato ca daḷhaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā ten'ev'ārammaṇena vimuttirasamasecanakaṃ pātabbaṃ.

na titthaṃ jānātī'ti titthaṃ saman'ti vā visaman'ti vā sagāhan'ti vā niggāhan'ti vā na jānāti, so atitthena gāviyo otāreti. tāsaṃ visamatitthe pāsāṇ'ādīni akkamantīnaṃ pādā bhijjanti, sagāhaṃ gambhīraṃ titthaṃ otiṇṇā kumbhīl'ādayo gāhā gaṇhanti.

83078.meaning1: there I was; in such-and-such a place I was
83078.commentary: (ITIa) amutrāsin'ti amumhi saṃvaṭṭakappe amumhi bhave vā yoniyā vā gatiyā vā viññāṇaṭṭhitiyā vā satt'āvāse vā sattanikāye vā aham'ahosiṃ.

examples.text: amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃ-sukhadukkha-ppaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrā'p'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃ-sukhadukkha-ppaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto idh'ūpapanno'ti.

atha mahāsatto kadāci imehi ānītā mama na rucceyya, sayam'eva tāva upadhārem'īti cintetvā evam'āha, devi, katip'āhaṃ mā kiñci rañño vadetha, ahaṃ ekaṃ kumārikaṃ sayaṃ pariyesitvā mama cittarucitaṃ tumhākaṃ ācikkhissāmī'ti. evaṃ karohi, tātā'ti.

83081.commentary: (VINa) kantitasuttan'ti dasikasutt'ādiṃ saṅghāṭetvā kantati, dukkantitaṃ vā paṭikantati.

examples.text: anāpatti kantitasuttaṃ kantati, ummattikāya, ādikammikāyā'ti.

kiṃ nu kho, bhante nāgasena, tathāgato saṅgharatanato na bhāriko na garuko na dakkhiṇeyyo, yaṃ tathāgato sakāya mātucchāya sayaṃ piñjitaṃ sayaṃ luñcitaṃ sayaṃ pothitaṃ sayaṃ kantitaṃ sayaṃ vāyitaṃ vassikasāṭikaṃ attano dīyamānaṃ saṅghassa dāpesi.

so tena puññakammena sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālassa gehe nibbattitvā yāva sattavassāni, tāva antoghare'y'eva vaḍḍhitvā sattame saṃvacchare upanayan'atthaṃ uyyānaṃ nīto antarāmagge jiṇṇ'āturamate disvā tesaṃ adiṭṭhapubbattā te parijane pucchitvā…

83083.meaning1: an old, a sick, and a dead man
83083.compound: dvanda (jiṇṇa ca ātura ca mata ca)

examples.text: so tena puññakammena sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālassa gehe nibbattitvā yāva sattavassāni, tāva antoghare'y'eva vaḍḍhitvā sattame saṃvacchare upanayan'atthaṃ uyyānaṃ nīto antarāmagge jiṇṇ'āturamate disvā tesaṃ adiṭṭhapubbattā te parijane pucchitvā…

83084.meaning1: fact of (something) never being seen before

examples.text: so tena puññakammena sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālassa gehe nibbattitvā yāva sattavassāni, tāva antoghare'y'eva vaḍḍhitvā sattame saṃvacchare upanayan'atthaṃ uyyānaṃ nīto antarāmagge jiṇṇ'āturamate disvā tesaṃ adiṭṭhapubbattā te parijane pucchitvā

83085.meaning1: fact of (something) never being seen before

examples.text: tato tena attabhāvena evarūpassa āhārassa cakkhunā'pi adiṭṭhapubbatāya tena paṭikūl'āhārena aṭṭiyamāno evaṃ attanā'va attānaṃ ovadi

83086.meaning1: fact of being indifferent; fact of being impartial; neutrality

examples.text: idāni'ssa udāsīnatāya upamaṃ dassento vissaṭṭhabhariyo viya puriso'ti-ādim'āha.

83087.meaning1: should be comforted; should be consoled; should be reassured

examples.text: idha, bhante nāgasena, ācariyena antevāsimhi satataṃ samitaṃ ārakkhā upaṭṭhapetabbā, asevanasevanā jānitabbā, pamatt'āppamattā jānitabbā, seyyavakāso jānitabbo, gelaññaṃ jānitabbaṃ, bhojanassa laddh'āladdhaṃ jānitabbaṃ, viseso jānitabbo, pattagataṃ saṃvibhajitabbaṃ, assāsitabbo mā bhāyi
evam'eva kho, ānanda, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visado'va nikkhamati amakkhito udena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visado'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso ekaṃ āmaṇḍaṃ hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sahasso brahmā sahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
suvihatan'ti pasāretvā suṭṭhu vihataṃ. ūnakasatasaṅkuvihatañ'hi nibbalikaṃ na hoti, saṅkusatena vihataṃ bheritalaṃ viya nibbalikaṃ hoti. tasmā evam'āha.
usūhi sattīhi ca sunisitāhi, hananti vijjhanti ca paccamittā, kāḷ'ūpakāḷā nirayamhi ghore, pubbe naraṃ dukkaṭakammakāriṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso khīr'atthiko khīragavesī khīrapariyesanaṃ caramāno gāviṃ taruṇavacchaṃ visāṇato āviñcheyya.

83093.meaning2: followed, pursued, used a medicine, etc.

83094.meaning1: (of sexual intercourse) who practices; who engages; who indulges (in)
83094.commentary: (VINa) n'ābhijānāmi supinantena'pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitā'ti supinantena'pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ na abhijānāmi, na paṭisevitā ahan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. atha vā paṭisevitā hutvā supinantena'pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāmī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. ye pana paṭisevitvā'ti paṭhan'ti tesaṃ ujukam'eva.

examples.text: sace tayā kataṃ katan'ti vadehi, sace tayā akataṃ akatanti vadehī'ti. yato ahaṃ, bhante, jāto n'ābhijānāmi supinantena'pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitā, pag'eva jāgaro'ti! atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, tena hi, bhikkhave, mettiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ nāsetha.

83095.meaning1: could be known; could be understood (by)
83095.commentary: (MNa) nekkhammena ñātabban'ti kāmato nissaṭaguṇena ñātabbaṃ. kāmato nissaṭaguṇe ṭhitena puggalena ek'aggaṃ nāma jānitabban'ti adhippāyen'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ taṃ nekkhammena ñātabbaṃ nekkhammena daṭṭhabbaṃ nekkhammena pattabbaṃ nekkhammena sacchikātabbaṃ taṃ vata jayaseno rājakumāro kāmamajjhe vasanto kāme paribhuñjanto kāmavitakkehi khajjamāno kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāno kāmapariyesanāya ussuko ñassati vā dakkhati vā sacchi vā karissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

83096.construction:
ud + su + ka + ya
ussuka + ya
83096.commentary: (THa) so ussukko kul'ūpasaṅkamane ussukkaṃ āpanno kulesu laddhabbesu madhur'ādi-rasesu anugiddho gedhaṃ āpanno tattha uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā'va yogaṃ āpajjanto.

examples.text: yaṃ taṃ nekkhammena ñātabbaṃ nekkhammena daṭṭhabbaṃ nekkhammena pattabbaṃ nekkhammena sacchikātabbaṃ taṃ vata jayaseno rājakumāro kāmamajjhe vasanto kāme paribhuñjanto kāmavitakkehi khajjamāno kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāno kāmapariyesanāya ussukko ñassati vā dakkhati vā sacchi vā karissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
kammaṃ bahukaṃ na kāraye, parivajjeyya janaṃ na uyyame, so ussukko ras'ānugiddho, atthaṃ riñcati yo sukh'ādhivāho.

tam'enaṃ dve sahāyakā tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā nikkhamitvā hatthavilaṅghakena yena so pabbato ten'upasaṅkameyyuṃ, upasaṅkamitvā eko sahāyako heṭṭhā pabbatapāde tiṭṭheyya, eko sahāyako uparipabbataṃ āroheyya.

tivarānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ cattārīsa vassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. tivarā, bhikkhave, manussā pācīnavaṃsaṃ pabbataṃ catūhena ārohanti, catūhena orohanti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.

83098.meaning1: (of a mountain) having made climb; having forced to ascend

examples.text: tam'enaṃ uparipabbate ṭhito sahāyako heṭṭhimapabbatapādaṃ orohitvā taṃ sahāyakaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā uparipabbataṃ āropetvā muhuttaṃ assāsetvā evaṃ vadeyya, yaṃ, samma, kiṃ tvaṃ passasi uparipabbate ṭhito'ti?
tam'enaṃ rañño nāgo abbhokāsaṃ nīharati. ettāvatā kho, aggivessana, āraññako nāgo abbhokāsaṃ gato hoti.
